import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.08,
})

archs = ['NORA', 'TracVLA', 'OpenVLA']
trained_frac = [13/16, 29/32, 23/32]
ref_frac = [14/16, 32/32, 26/32]
trained_labels = ['13/16', '29/32', '23/32']
ref_labels = ['14/16', '32/32', '26/32']

y = np.arange(len(archs))
h = 0.35

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 2.5))
bars_ref = ax.barh(y + h/2, ref_frac, h, color='#56B4E9', label='Reference')
bars_tr = ax.barh(y - h/2, trained_frac, h, color='#0072B2', label='Trained')

for bar, label in zip(bars_ref, ref_labels):
    ax.text(bar.get_width() + 0.02, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, label, va='center', fontsize=8)
for bar, label in zip(bars_tr, trained_labels):
    ax.text(bar.get_width() + 0.02, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, label, va='center', fontsize=8)

ax.axvline(0.5, color='lightgray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.set_yticks(y)
ax.set_yticklabels(archs)
ax.set_xlabel('Fraction of instruction-dominant heads')
ax.set_xlim(0, 1.15)
ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/root/vla-ssd/paper_figures/fig_l1_attention.pdf')
plt.savefig('/root/vla-ssd/paper_figures/fig_l1_attention.png', dpi=300)
print('Done')
PYEOF
